title: Grade 2 Science — Wed, May 27
description: Animals Around Us — Day 3 of 5: What animals eat
subject: science

questions.question: An animal that eats ONLY plants is called a ___.
questions.explanation: Herbivore = herb (plant) eater. Cows, goats, rabbits, and deer are herbivores.

questions.question: An animal that eats ONLY other animals (meat) is called a ___.
questions.explanation: Carnivore = carne (meat) eater. Lions, tigers, and sharks are carnivores.

questions.question: An animal that eats BOTH plants and animals is called a ___.
questions.explanation: Omnivore = eats everything. Bears, humans, and dogs are omnivores.

questions.question: A cow eats grass and plants. What type of animal is a cow?
questions.explanation: A cow eats only plants (grass, hay, leaves) — so it is a herbivore.

questions.question: A lion hunts and eats deer. What type of animal is a lion?
questions.explanation: A lion eats only meat (other animals) — so it is a carnivore.

questions.question: A bear eats fish, berries, and honey. What type of animal is a bear?
questions.explanation: A bear eats both plants (berries, honey) and animals (fish) — so it is an omnivore.

questions.question: Which of these is a herbivore?
questions.explanation: Rabbits eat only plants (grass, carrots, leaves) — they are herbivores.

questions.question: Which of these is a carnivore?
questions.explanation: Tigers hunt and eat other animals — they are carnivores. Cows, deer, and elephants are herbivores.

questions.question: Humans eat rice, vegetables, and chicken. What are humans?
questions.explanation: Humans eat both plants (rice, vegetables) and animals (chicken, fish) — we are omnivores.

questions.question: A frog eats insects. What kind of animal is it?
questions.explanation: Frogs eat insects and small animals — they are carnivores (or insectivores, which is a type of carnivore).

questions.question: Which animal eats both grass and small animals?
questions.explanation: Crows eat seeds, fruits, and also insects and small animals — they are omnivores.

questions.question: What do herbivores eat?
questions.explanation: Herbivores eat ONLY plants — grass, leaves, fruits, seeds, roots.

questions.question: A shark eats only fish and seals. It is a ___.
questions.explanation: Sharks eat only other animals — they are carnivores and top predators of the sea.

questions.question: Elephants eat leaves, bark, fruits, and grass. What are they?
questions.explanation: Elephants eat only plant material — they are herbivores, and the world's largest land herbivore.

questions.question: Which group is correct?
questions.explanation: Humans, bears, and crows all eat both plants and animals — they are correctly classified as omnivores.
